blockingFindings.summary: Stage contracts are candidate-item schemas, not complete response envelopes.
blockingFindings.evidence: Stage 1 has no response-level entities collection or abstention decision, and Stage 2 has no response-level relations collection or explicit no-relation/abstention state.
blockingFindings.impact: The approved abstention precision/recall/F1 gates and response-level cardinality/fail-closed rules cannot be represented or validated.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Version response envelopes around both item schemas, including explicit abstention/no-relation semantics, bounded collection sizes, schema version and additionalProperties=false.

blockingFindings.summary: The scorer cannot compute the approved eligibility metrics.
blockingFindings.evidence: Entity scoring emits one pooled entityF1 rather than macro-by-type F1; abstention emits only per-case correctness; relation scoring omits macro-by-predicate F1, predicate accuracy, endpoint-direction accuracy, missing/reversed endpoint rates and relation hallucination rate.
blockingFindings.impact: A future preregistration could bind thresholds that the evaluator cannot calculate or reconcile from per-case records.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Implement every approved threshold metric with explicit numerators, denominators, zero-denominator states, per-case records and aggregate reconciliation tests.

blockingFindings.summary: The fixture set does not implement all three approved oracle arms.
blockingFindings.evidence: The three fixture IDs are gold-relations-integrity, semantic-buckets and evidence-buckets; there is no paired predicted-entities versus gold-entities fixture whose only changed input is the candidate table.
blockingFindings.impact: The package does not yet demonstrate that the planned ablation isolates stage-1 entity quality from stage-2 decoding.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Add paired gold-/predicted-entity fixtures with identical context, prompt contract and gold relations, plus a separate deterministic gold-relations integrity control. Distinguish oracle fixtures from scorer unit fixtures in accounting.

blockingFindings.summary: Evidence support is measured as endpoint-span containment rather than registered trigger/evidence support.
blockingFindings.evidence: supportedNonExact is assigned when the predicted evidence span covers both endpoint entity spans; no trigger, clause or gold-evidence support relation is checked.
blockingFindings.impact: A broad span containing endpoints can pass relationEvidenceSupport even when it does not support the predicate, invalidating the approved evidence threshold.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Bind support to the versioned trigger/evidence contract and add adversarial fixtures where endpoint coverage exists without predicate support.

blockingFindings.summary: The zero-call preflight can report readiness without validating the offline package.
blockingFindings.evidence: Preflight does not load s12-f-12-offline-contracts.v1.json, verify its declared digests, import/run the scorer fixtures, or reconcile the approved thresholds. It checks only artifact presence and a few governance flags.
blockingFindings.impact: OFFLINE_CONTRACTS_READY_ZERO_CALL is a false-positive-prone custody statement rather than a reproducibility proof.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Bind the exact review, schemas, scorer, fixtures and tests by digest/commit; execute deterministic fixtures and threshold-coverage checks inside preflight; add tamper and missing-artifact tests.

blockingFindings.evidence: The offline-contract artifact omits the approved missingEndpointRateMax and reversedEndpointRateMax values and collapses distinct entity/relation hallucination thresholds into one generic hallucinationRateMax field.
blockingFindings.impact: A later preregistration could silently weaken or ambiguously apply the owner-approved gates.
blockingFindings.requiredRemediation: Bind the complete threshold tree from the RM-19 review without renaming or collapsing metrics, then validate exact equality in preflight.

constraints: Preserve offline contracts v1 and its seven passing tests as historical evidence.
Do not preregister, freeze an execution package or call a provider from RM-20A.
A superseding offline package requires a separate RM-21 owner re-review.
